service.method: SELECT row_number() over () as num -- 번호 , POLN.po_number -- 구매오더 , BOM.material_number -- 자재코드 , BOM.description_loc -- 자재명 , BOM.bom_qty -- 수량 , BOM.bom_unit_measure -- 단위 , BOM.material_number_bom -- 사급자재코드 , BOM.description_loc_bom -- 사급자재명 , BOM.base_qty -- 기준수량 FROM SPOLN POLN, SBOM BOM WHERE 1=1 AND POLN.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND POLN.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.BUYER_COMPANY_CODE} AND POLN.SELLER_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND poasrm_std.NVL(POLN.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND POLN.MATERIAL_NUMBER = BOM.MATERIAL_NUMBER

INSERT INTO SOSLN( house_code, company_code, plant_code, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, ADD_USER_ID, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, CHANGE_USER_ID, DEL_FLAG, so_number, so_seq, material_number_bom, description_loc_bom, bom_qty, req_qty, bom_unit_measure, po_number, po_seq, seller_code, seller_name_loc, material_number, description_loc, base_qty ) VALUES ( ${session.HOUSE_CODE}, ${session.BUYER_COMPANY_CODE}, ${PLANT_CODE}, ${current.DATE}, ${current.TIME}, ${session.ID}, ${current.DATE}, ${current.TIME}, ${session.ID}, 'N', ${SO_NUMBER}, ${SO_SEQ}, ${MATERIAL_NUMBER_BOM}, ${DESCRIPTION_LOC_BOM}, ${BOM_QTY}, ${REQ_QTY}, ${session.COMPANY_CODE}, ${session.COMPANY_NAME}, ${MATERIAL_NUMBER}, ${DESCRIPTION_LOC}, ${BASE_QTY} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE CHANGE_DATE = ${current.DATE}, CHANGE_TIME = ${current.TIME}, CHANGE_USER_ID = ${session.ID}, so_number = ${SO_NUMBER}, so_seq = ${SO_SEQ}, material_number_bom = ${MATERIAL_NUMBER_BOM}, description_loc_bom = ${DESCRIPTION_LOC_BOM}, bom_qty = ${BOM_QTY}, req_qty = ${REQ_QTY}, seller_code = ${session.COMPANY_CODE}, seller_name_loc = ${session.COMPANY_NAME}, plant_code = ${PLANT_CODE}, material_number = ${MATERIAL_NUMBER}, description_loc = ${DESCRIPTION_LOC}, base_qty = ${BASE_QTY}
